✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro


A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Staff AI Engineer | AI Orchestration & SDLC Automation para se juntar ao nosso time no Brasil (Porto Alegre/RS ou São Paulo/RS)


O que você vai fazer

Estamos buscando uma pessoa que irá atuar como Staff-level Engineer para projetar e gerenciar uma camada de orquestração de IA incorporada em nossos pipelines de CI/CD, transformando a IA em uma capacidade de engenharia de software controlada e escalável.

Essa função é responsável por institucionalizar agentes de IA (começando com Devin), automatizando o ciclo de vida do software de ponta a ponta, preservando a propriedade e a responsabilidade humanas.


AI Orchestration & Architecture:

Projetar e implementar uma camada de orquestração de IA integrada ao pipeline de CI/CD.

Orquestrar agentes e habilidades de IA em todas as etapas do SDLC (design, desenvolvimento, teste, refatoração).

Definir como as sessões de IA são criadas, gerenciadas, versionadas, auditadas e revisadas.


Context Engineering at Scale:

Projetar mecanismos para provisionar automaticamente o contexto por projeto, incluindo:

  • Bases de código
  • Arquitetura e documentação
  • Padrões e políticas
  • Histórico de tickets e incidentes

Garantir que a IA opere com um contexto preciso, delimitado e em conformidade desde o primeiro dia.


SDLC Automation & Ticket Flow

Automatize fluxos de trabalho a partir de tickets do Jira:

  • Ingestão e classificação de tickets
  • Criação automática de sessões de IA
  • Vinculação de contexto e definição do escopo da tarefa
  • Ciclos de revisão e aprovação humana

Habilite a rastreabilidade de ticket → código → testes → implantação.


CI/CD Integration

Incorpore a orquestração de IA em pipelines de CI/CD para:

  • Geração e modificação de código
  • Geração e manutenção automatizadas de testes
  • Revisões de PR e verificações de qualidade
  • Verificações de conformidade e segurança

Garanta que os resultados da IA sejam governados, repetíveis e mensuráveis.


Devin Deployment & Scaling

• Liderar a implementação inicial do Devin em toda a organização.

• Definir padrões de uso, diretrizes e modelos de adoção.

• Garantir que o Devin evolua de uma ferramenta para uma capacidade de engenharia padronizada.


Measurement & Governance

  • Definir métricas para medir o impacto da IA na produtividade, qualidade e confiabilidade.
  • Garantir que toda a atividade de IA seja observável, auditável e alinhada com a governança corporativa.
  • Aprimorar continuamente a orquestração com base em resultados e feedback.


Technical Leadership

  • Atuar como responsável técnico pela IA dentro do SDLC (Ciclo de Vida de Desenvolvimento de Software).
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Plataforma, DevOps, QA (Garantia da Qualidade), Segurança e Arquitetura.
  • Orientar engenheiros seniores e definir as melhores práticas.


✅ O que buscamos em você

• Sólida experiência profissional em engenharia de software.

• Liderança técnica comprovada em nível de equipe/principal.

• Sólida experiência em engenharia de plataforma, CI/CD e ferramentas internas.

• Experiência na construção de sistemas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho.

• Experiência prática na integração de agentes de IA ou LLMs em pipelines de produção.

• Experiência em ambientes regulamentados de grande escala.

• Experiência em desenvolvimento.


✅ Required skills

Platform & Orchestration

• Sistemas distribuídos e orquestração de fluxos de trabalho

• Design de pipelines CI/CD

• APIs, SDKs e frameworks de automação

• Observabilidade e auditabilidade


Applied AI

• Modelos de Aprendizagem Baseados em Lógica (LLMs), orquestração de agentes, chamada de ferramentas

• Engenharia de contexto e RAG (Random Access Group - Grupo de Ação Racional)

• Fluxos de trabalho com interação humana

• Avaliação de resultados de IA e controle de qualidade


SDLC & Quality

• Fluxos de trabalho baseados em Git

• Estratégias de teste automatizadas

• Controles de qualidade e aplicação de conformidade

• Produtividade do desenvolvedor e métricas de experiência do desenvolvedor


O que oferecemos

title: Engenheiro DevOps (inglês fluente)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:


• Instalar, configurar, administrar e dar suporte a sistemas e serviços de Core Banking em diferentes ambientes (DEV/UAT/PROD).

• Automatizar atividades operacionais e de deploy utilizando Rundeck e Ansible (orquestração de jobs, playbooks/roles, inventários e gerenciamento seguro de credenciais).

• Criar e manter runbooks, procedimentos operacionais e documentação padrão para permitir execuções repetíveis e auditáveis.

• Fornecer suporte à produção e participar da resposta a incidentes, incluindo triagem, correção e análises pós-incidente (RCA/gestão de problemas).

• Monitorar a saúde e o desempenho dos sistemas; implementar melhorias proativas em disponibilidade, resiliência e capacidade.

• Gerenciar configuração, aplicação de patches e ciclo de vida de componentes de sistema operacional, middleware e aplicações, garantindo conformidade com controles internos.

• Coordenar o controle, renovação e implantação de certificados digitais (ex.: TLS/SSL), incluindo inventário, monitoramento de vencimento, planejamento de mudanças, validação e documentação para evitar interrupções de serviço.

• Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

• Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

• Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

• Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.


Requisitos:

• Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras; conhecimento do mercado financeiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

• Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

• Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

• Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

• Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

• Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

• Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

• Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders; capacidade de trabalhar com fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejável:

• Experiência com SAFe; exposição ao GCP.

• Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

• Espanhol.

title: Desenvolvedor C++
description:
Cód. 59232


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Dev, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvimento avançado em C/C++ (atuação direta no core transacional de autorizador de cartões).
  • Experiência em AWS (nível intermediário) para apoiar/implementar a modernização e migração da plataforma para cloud.
  • Conhecimentos intermediários de Linux (operação, troubleshooting e ambiente de execução).
  • Automação e infraestrutura como código : Terraform + práticas de CI/CD (nível intermediário).
  • Suporte ao ecossistema de desenvolvimento e dados : Python e SQL (nível intermediário), além de boa colaboração/proatividade e foco em performance/risco.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Application Support Engineer (DevOPS | Data Product Support | Brazil)
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Mission Description


We are looking for an Application Support Engineer to establish and drive operational support for Data Products within a complex, data-driven environment at world’s leading investment bank as our customer.

You will play a key role in incident management, system stability, and knowledge transfer, while working closely with global teams across the globe. The role combines production support, data analysis, and light development to ensure high availability and performance of critical data services.


What you’ll do


Core Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 application support for Data applications
  • Manage incident resolution and service restoration in production environments
  • Perform log analysis, debugging, and root cause investigations
  • Monitor and support data pipelines and data processing workflows
  • Execute and optimize SQL queries (Snowflake and other DBs)
  • Work with Unix/Linux environments for file, process, and system operations
  • Support AWS-based services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda)
  • Collaborate with global teams during operational hours

Additional Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain runbooks and support documentation
  • Support knowledge transfer activities from vendors or internal teams
  • Contribute to automation and development tasks (Python / Java scripting)
  • Assist in testing and stabilization phases of new product releases

Profile Requirements


Mandatory

  • 3+ years in Application Support / Production Support / Data Support roles
  • Strong SQL skills (Snowflake preferred)
  • Experience with Python or Java (scripting, automation, or support tooling)
  • Solid understanding of incident management (ITIL processes)
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Unix/Linux environments (CLI, file/process management)
  • Log analysis & troubleshooting
  • Good communication skills and fluent English


Nice to have

  • Exposure to ETL pipelines / data integration workflows
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Background in banking or financial sector or financial data / market data environments
  • Familiarity with:
  • Alloy
  • VLF-based query languages / Slang
  • Experience in high-availability environments


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: Data Software Engineer (US/UK International Projects)
description:
Software Engineer - Data Platform (International Client)

Location: Florianópolis, Brazil | Hybrid

Language: English (daily use with US/UK clients)


About the Opportunity

Join our consultancy team and work directly with a leading insurance company in the US/UK, building their complete data platform from the ground up. This is your chance to bring world-class, AI augmented software engineering practices to a greenfield data engineering project while collaborating daily with international teams.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build a robust data platform for a major insurance company
  • Orchestrate AI agents to research, plan and implement complex data pipelines while demonstrating to the wider team how to leverage these tools to increase velocity and quality.
  • Bring solid software engineering principles to data engineering challenges
  • Work embedded within the client's team, driving technical excellence
  • Collaborate in English with distributed teams across the US and UK


What We're Looking For

Must Have:

  • Excellent communication skills in English - you'll be working daily with international clients
  • Strong software engineering mindset - clean code, testing, reliability, and maintainability are in your DNA
  • Deep understanding of relational databases and large-scale data systems
  • Full AI-Augmented Development - you're already using AI agents and modern dev tools


You'll Thrive Here If:

  • You want international exposure while staying in Brazil
  • You value engineering excellence over quick fixes
  • You're excited about hybrid work (office + remote flexibility in Floripa)
  • You see data engineering as a software engineering discipline


About Us

We're a Florianópolis-based software development and consultancy company working with clients in the US and UK. We believe in combining the best of Brazilian tech talent with international opportunities.


Ready to level up your career with international experience? Let's talk.

Com mais de 600 profissionais dedicados e escritórios em Lisboa, Porto, Madrid e Luxemburgo, a Decskill atua hoje em três áreas de negócio:

  • Decskill Talent: Acreditamos que as nossas pessoas são fundamentais para o nosso sucesso de todos. Através da Decskill Talent, capacitamos e acompanhamos equipas em desafios da transformação digital dos nossos clientes. O sucesso da Decskill é construído pelo foco nas nossas pessoas e pela capacidade de enfrentar os desafios da transformação digital com agilidade e flexibilidade. Criamos valor não só para os nossos clientes, mas também para todo o nosso ecossistema onde fomentamos uma comunidade digital dedicada ao crescimento dos negócios através da tecnologia.


Estamos a recrutar um Fullstack Developer para integrar um projeto remoto .

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência como full-stack developer.
  • Experiência sólida em C#/.NET e Python .
  • Experiência sólida com React 18, TypeScript e TailwindCSS .

  • Design e implementação de REST APIs .
  • Conhecimentos de Git e CI/CD .
  • Fluência em Português.

Se a oportunidade corresponde às suas expectativas envie-nos o seu CV para o email com a referência “CN/DBR”

description:

Support daily operations for SAP Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes, including issue resolution, user support, and change management.

Makes decisions applicable to level of influence in the organization. Collaborate with cross functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Utilize technical and functional expertise to support Procurement, Finance, and Tax initiatives.

Participate in or lead projects implementing or upgrading, tax localization, and compliance solutions.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

  • Experience with:

  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments

  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Vibecoder
description:
A Human é um ecossistema criado por criativos para criativos, que nasceu para explorar o encontro entre criatividade humana e inteligência artificial.


Nascemos da prática e estamos criando projetos reais, testando novas ferramentas e desenvolvendo novos fluxos de trabalho todos os dias dentro de empresas como Google, Nestlé e Stone.


Acreditamos que a inteligência artificial não substitui a criatividade, mas expande as possibilidades de quem cria.

Por isso, construímos um ambiente onde pessoas curiosas, inquietas e mão na massa podem explorar, testar, errar, aprender rápido e evoluir junto com o mercado (e junto com a gente).


Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Criar ferramentas, automações e integrações com IA que melhorem o dia a dia dos nossos times;
  • Desenvolver workflows inteligentes para projetos criativos e campanhas;
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com times criativos, estratégicos e de produto;
  • Testar e implementar novas ferramentas (Lovable, Replit, Claude Code, GPT Codex, etc.);
  • Transformar IA em processo (não só em experimentação).


Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência construindo produtos (projetos próprios, freelas, startups ou dentro de empresas);
  • Familiaridade com vibe coding e ferramentas de AI-assisted coding;
  • Mentalidade prática: tirar ideias do papel rápido;
  • Boa comunicação para colaborar com times criativos;
  • Interesse real por criatividade, cultura e tecnologia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência criando automações ou agentes de IA;
  • Vivência com ferramentas como Cursor, v0, Bolt, Replit, entre outras;
  • Já ter atuado em projetos criativos ou campanhas;
  • Interesse em explorar novas formas de criação com IA.

title: Senior Delphi Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Developer with 5+ years of Delphi software development experience to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Write well-designed, testable, documented code from the provided project requirements
  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Implement software changes with the awareness and sensitivity of impact on the system as a whole
  • Learn and adhere to the adopted coding standards used by the software ERP Development Team
  • Leverage Delphi experience and learn all other client development tools
  • Monitor assigned software development change requests and implement changes for requests based on priority
  • Review requirements for system changes and enhancements, analyze those requests, and translate them into necessary programming changes
  • Perform necessary designing, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation (using the Delphi IDE and any other necessary tools)


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of Delphi and SQL Server experience (FireDAC experience is a plus)
  • Experience with at least one object-oriented programming language (in addition to Delphi/Object Pascal) is a plus, e.g., Java, C#, C++, etc.
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, cross-training, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Implementing unit tests (DUnitX experience is a plus)


Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry and any related applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding the fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning and management tools such as GitHub
  • Working with AI tools within the development workflow


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: AI Python Developer
description:
Role Overview

Client is seeking highly skilled Python Software Engineers to support complex data workloads and AI‑driven systems . This role is ideal for engineers who are deeply hands‑on with Python and PySpark , comfortable working in production environments , and experienced contributing to or actively engaging with open‑source communities .

This position will focus on building production‑grade APIs, scalable data pipelines, and developer tooling , while collaborating across engineering, product, and data teams.

Top Requirement: Candidates must be very strong in Python and PySpark . This is non‑negotiable and should be the primary focus during technical screening.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop production‑grade Python services and APIs supporting AI and data platforms
  • Build and optimize PySpark workloads to support large‑scale data processing
  • Contribute to AI systems and complex data pipelines in production environments
  • Develop developer tooling to streamline the software delivery lifecycle
  • Implement observability, monitoring, and performance optimization strategies
  • Practice infrastructure‑as‑code and deployment automation
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and data teams on architecture and system design
  • Participate in and contribute to technical discussions and design reviews


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong Python expertise (primary language)
  • Strong PySpark experience working with large datasets
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , primarily in Python
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field
  • Experience contributing to open‑source projects
  • Code contributions, PRs, or
  • Meaningful participation via issues, discussions, or proposals in major libraries (data science, ML, or LLM ecosystems)
  • Strong experience with Git and platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket
  • Experience developing APIs using FastAPI
  • Experience with ML / data libraries such as Scikit‑Learn, TensorFlow , or similar
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Experience with containers, orchestration systems, and serverless technologies
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical decisions clearly


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain and/or LangFlow
  • Background supporting LLM‑based or AI‑driven applications
  • Experience building data‑intensive platforms in production
  • Exposure to distributed systems and large‑scale data architectures

We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.

Our platform powers advanced AI workflows such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, document intelligence, and structured data search — with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability in production environments.


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help design, build, and scale both the backend systems and frontend experiences of our AI platform. You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.

This role is ideal for engineers who think end-to-end: you care about clean API design and reliable backend architecture, but you're equally motivated by building polished, responsive interfaces that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive.


Responsibilities


Backend & Platform

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services in Python
  • Develop and evolve RESTful and WebSocket APIs supporting AI workflows and enterprise use cases
  • Build and maintain AI orchestration layers (RAG pipelines, agent systems, retrieval modules)
  • Integrate multiple data sources: vector databases, structured/tabular data, files, and web search
  • Own backend architecture decisions with a strong focus on performance, security, and reliability


Frontend & User Experience

  • Build and iterate on production React interfaces using Next.js and TypeScript
  • Translate complex AI capabilities into clean, usable UI patterns — from research dashboards to interactive data views
  • Implement real-time features such as streaming responses, live status indicators, and dynamic content updates
  • Ensure frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices


Cross-Cutting

  • Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end
  • Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and automated testing across the stack
  • Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
  • Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software
  • Strong proficiency in Python with experience building backend services (FastAPI or similar)
  • Strong proficiency in React with experience in Next.js and TypeScript
  • Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases
  • Comfort working across the full stack — you don't need to be told where the problem is
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI agent systems
  • Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search (e.g. OpenSearch)
  • Experience with real-time interfaces (WebSockets, streaming, SSE)
  • Background in enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with Vercel for frontend hosting and deployment
  • Knowledge of authentication systems (e.g. Clerk, Auth0)
  • Knowledge of security best practices and compliance (SOC 2 is a plus)
  • Experience working with high-scale or high-availability systems


What We Offer

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems used by enterprise customers
  • High-impact role with ownership across the full stack
  • Flexible remote work (Worldwide)
  • Direct collaboration with experienced engineers and founders
  • Fast-paced environment with real production challenges
  • Strong influence on technical and product decisions


Location Remote (Worldwide)

Hiring Model Contractor


How to Apply Please reply here with your CV or portfolio. If you enjoy building serious full-stack systems for real AI products — from the Python services that power intelligent workflows to the React interfaces that put them in users' hands — we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences

Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

title: Video Editor – Part-Time, Remote
description:
Hours: 20 hours/week

Location: Remote


About Wildfleur

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transform UGC, influencer clips, and brand shoots into ads that feel authentic, on-trend, and true to our brand identity.
  • Edit raw footage into short, engaging TikTok and Instagram videos.
  • Use eye-catching edits: clean transitions, quick cuts, trending sounds, and storytelling hooks.
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and effects while keeping the skincare/beauty audience in mind.
  • Ensure videos are exported in the correct formats, resolutions, and aspect ratios for each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and paid ads).
  • Stay on top of TikTok & Instagram trends.
  • Keep video assets organized and workflows smooth for ongoing projects.


Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio of short-form content.
  • Proven track record of creating high-converting paid social media ads and working extensively with UGC.
  • Portfolio examples in beauty, skincare, or cosmetics content are preferred - you understand the audience and the aesthetics.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written, for seamless communication and creating platform-native captions.
  • Passionate about cosmetics/skincare culture - you enjoy this world and bring genuine interest into the content.
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
  • Comfortable working in CapCut or mobile-friendly apps when quick, social-native edits are needed.
  • Up-to-date with social media culture, trends, hooks, and viral formats.
  • Strong technical knowledge of video requirements for social media (aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, file sizes, export settings).
  • Highly detail-oriented, delivering content that is both on-trend and brand-consistent.
  • A degree in a creative field (film, media, communications, design) or background in filming/content creation is a plus (not required).


Perks

  • Flexible remote schedule.
  • Be part of a supportive and creative team

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (React / Python / Go or Node.js or Java)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and either Golang, Node.js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Position Overview

Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
  • Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
  • Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
  • Coordinate with internal teams including eDiscovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
  • Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
  • Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
  • Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion


Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
  • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus


About Gemean

Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like PythAI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python + React) — AI StartupSenior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Productivity Platform (Remote)
description:
Position: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI Platform)


About Us

We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.

Our platform powers advanced AI workflows such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, document intelligence, and structured data search — with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability in production environments.


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help design, build, and scale both the backend systems and frontend experiences of our AI platform. You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.

This role is ideal for engineers who think end-to-end: you care about clean API design and reliable backend architecture, but you're equally motivated by building polished, responsive interfaces that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive.


Responsibilities


Backend & Platform

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services in Python
  • Develop and evolve RESTful and WebSocket APIs supporting AI workflows and enterprise use cases
  • Build and maintain AI orchestration layers (RAG pipelines, agent systems, retrieval modules)
  • Integrate multiple data sources: vector databases, structured/tabular data, files, and web search
  • Own backend architecture decisions with a strong focus on performance, security, and reliability


Frontend & User Experience

  • Build and iterate on production React interfaces using Next.js and TypeScript
  • Translate complex AI capabilities into clean, usable UI patterns — from research dashboards to interactive data views
  • Implement real-time features such as streaming responses, live status indicators, and dynamic content updates
  • Ensure frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices


Cross-Cutting

  • Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end
  • Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and automated testing across the stack
  • Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
  • Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software
  • Strong proficiency in Python with experience building backend services (FastAPI or similar)
  • Strong proficiency in React with experience in Next.js and TypeScript
  • Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases
  • Comfort working across the full stack — you don't need to be told where the problem is
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI agent systems
  • Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search (e.g. OpenSearch)
  • Experience with real-time interfaces (WebSockets, streaming, SSE)
  • Background in enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with Vercel for frontend hosting and deployment
  • Knowledge of authentication systems (e.g. Clerk, Auth0)
  • Knowledge of security best practices and compliance (SOC 2 is a plus)
  • Experience working with high-scale or high-availability systems


What We Offer

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems used by enterprise customers
  • High-impact role with ownership across the full stack
  • Flexible remote work (Worldwide)
  • Direct collaboration with experienced engineers and founders
  • Fast-paced environment with real production challenges
  • Strong influence on technical and product decisions


Location Remote (Worldwide)

Hiring Model Contractor


How to Apply Please reply here with your CV or portfolio. If you enjoy building serious full-stack systems for real AI products — from the Python services that power intelligent workflows to the React interfaces that put them in users' hands — we'd love to hear from you.

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar da análise e interpretação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, colaborando com times de Produto, Qualidade e QA desde as fases iniciais;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, organizado e aderente aos padrões técnicos da Sankhya;
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;
  • Colaborar com a automação de testes e validação técnica das entregas, contribuindo para a robustez das versões liberadas;
  • Apoiar o time na definição de critérios de aceite, estratégias de teste e validação de cenários críticos;
  • Participar da definição de estimativas de esforço e planos de entrega, com visão integrada entre desenvolvimento e qualidade;
  • Atuar ativamente nos ritos ágeis do time (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas), promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua;
  • Registrar e manter documentação técnica clara das funcionalidades desenvolvidas ou modificadas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico, boas práticas e aprendizados com o time, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência e colaboração.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java (com foco em orientação a objetos);
  • Conhecimentos nas principais API Java (java.util, java.util.stream, java.time, java.util.concurrent).
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em frameworks de font-end como AngularJS ou React, além de HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacional como por exemplo: SQL Server e Oracle (consultas, tuning, modelagem e estrutura relacional);
  • Escrita de consultas avançadas (JOINs, índices) e análise de planos de execução
  • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando GIT;
  • Desejável vivência com frameworks como Spring, JPA e aplicação de design patterns;
  • Interesse ou experiência prática em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e ferramentas para sua implementação como por exemplo (JUnit e Mockito).
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e suas ferramentas (Robot Framework, CyPress, Postman).
  • Conhecimento em escrita de testes usando ferramentas como gherkin.
  • Mentalidade de qualidade: valorizamos profissionais que consideram a excelência técnica desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega, com atenção a performance, cobertura de testes e prevenção de bugs.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Position Overview

Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
  • Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
  • Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
  • Coordinate with internal teams including eDiscovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
  • Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
  • Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
  • Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion


Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
  • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus


About Gemean

Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like PythAI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
  • Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
  • Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
  • Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
  • Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
  • Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
  • Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
  • Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
  • Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

  • Forte entendimento de OpenAPI (Swagger)

  • Experiência na implementação e uso de OpenTelemetry

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.

  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components

  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
